name: Olmsted County, MN
findings: Olmsted County has 622 nonprofit organizations. 311 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 249 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Olmsted County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 25 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 6 foundation organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do foundation organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
